title: Library reopening
passage:
When will the renovated library reopen?
A. I borrowed it yesterday. B. At the desk near the window. C. The notice says next Monday.
passageZh:
整修後的圖書館何時重新開放？
A. 我昨天借了它。
B. 在窗邊的櫃檯。
C. 公告說是下星期一。
